messages:
jamie: Quick check: finalizing inbound routing & schema for next week's launch — can we map form intents to landing pages + add Event/FAQ schema for the webinar? Need to ship by EOD Thurs.

lara: On it. Can you share current intent buckets? I have a draft mapping.

jamie: Buckets: trial, pricing, enterprise, research/demo, partner. Prioritize organic landing pages for 'LLM inference cost optimization' and 'dedicated inference SLA'.

mike: For routing, let's attach a hidden input `intent` and map server-side:

`if intent==enterprise -> /solutions/enterprise-inference?utm_source=form&utm_campaign=launch`

Also make sure the server returns proper canonical and X-Robots header if we test staging.

sophie: I can add JSON-LD for Event + FAQ. Example to sanity-check:

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference Launch Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-07T16:00:00Z",
  "location": {
    "@type": "VirtualLocation",
    "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar"
  }
}
```

ana: Internal linking: update the 'Inference' pillar to add 3 contextual links to the new benchmark + landing pages. Use natural anchor text like 'inference latency benchmarks' and 'reducing per-token cost', not exact-match spam.

olivia: Webinar registration flow note — map `form.intent=webinar` -> tag lead as `interest:webinar-2026-04-07`, push to SFDC campaign + Marketo nurture. Also set GTM event `form_submit` with `intent` and `webinar_date`.

mike: I'll run a redirect sweep tomorrow morning. Suggested rewrite for legacy slug:

`RewriteRule ^/old-launch/(.*)$ /launch/$1 [R=302,L]`

We'll QA then flip to 301 after 72h.

sophie: Also ensure canonical points to production canonical URL and add rel=prev/next for paginated guides. No hreflang needed for this launch.

jamie: Great. @ana — can you open a PR with the internal link updates by 1pm? @mike — confirm redirect sweep done by EOD. I'll drop the Notion doc link after PR.

ana: Yep, will PR by 12:45. :thumbsup:

mike: Sweep scheduled 9am PT. I'll post results in this thread.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: content/redirects v1 -> staging at 2026-03-26T09:00Z

jamie: Thanks everyone — tracking in the launch checklist. :rocket:
